tools.name: Arcade_ListApps
tools.description: See the apps the current caller can act on and whether they are connected. Returns each app's id, name, connected state, and (when connected) the account it is connected as. Call this to answer "what apps do I have?" or when the caller's connection state may have changed since the session started.

tools.name: GoogleCalendar_CreateEvent
tools.description: Create a new event/meeting/sync/meetup in the specified calendar. Pass `recurrence` to create a repeating event.

params.name: summary
params.description: The title of the event

params.name: location
params.description: The location of the event

params.name: recurrence
params.description: Recurrence rules for a repeating event, in RFC 5545 format. Each entry is an RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE line; a bare rule is automatically prefixed with 'RRULE:'. Examples: ['RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR;

params.name: visibility
params.description: The visibility of the event

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: The ID of the calendar to create the event in, usually 'primary'.

params.name: description
params.description: The description of the event

params.name: end_datetime
params.description: The datetime when the event ends in ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-12-31T17:30:00'.

params.name: start_datetime
params.description: The datetime when the event starts in ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-12-31T15:30:00'.

params.name: add_google_meet
params.description: Whether to add a Google Meet link to the event. Defaults to False.

params.name: attendee_emails
params.description: The list of attendee emails. Must be valid email addresses e.g., username@domain.com.

params.name: send_notifications_to_attendees
params.description: Should attendees be notified by email of the invitation? (none, all, external_only)

tools.name: GoogleCalendar_DeleteEvent
tools.description: Delete an event from Google Calendar.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID of the event to delete

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: The ID of the calendar containing the event

params.name: send_updates
params.description: Specifies which attendees to notify about the deletion

tools.name: GoogleCalendar_FindTimeSlotsWhenEveryoneIsFree
tools.description: Provides time slots when everyone is free within a given date range and time boundaries.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date to search for time slots in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Defaults to seven days from the start date. It will search until this date at the time 23:59:59.

params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date to search for time slots in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Defaults to today's date. It will search starting from this date at the time 00:00:00.

params.name: email_addresses
params.description: The list of email addresses from people in the same organization domain (apart from the currently logged in user) to search for free time slots. Defaults to None, which will return free time slots for

params.name: end_time_boundary
params.description: Will return free slots in any given day until this time in the format 'HH:MM'. Defaults to '18:00', which is a usual business hour end time.

params.name: start_time_boundary
params.description: Will return free slots in any given day starting from this time in the format 'HH:MM'. Defaults to '08:00', which is a usual business hour start time.

tools.name: GoogleCalendar_ListCalendars
tools.description: List all calendars accessible by the user.

params.name: max_results
params.description: The maximum number of calendars to return. Up to 250 calendars, defaults to 10.

params.name: show_hidden
params.description: Whether to show hidden calendars. Defaults to False

params.name: show_deleted
params.description: Whether to show deleted calendars. Defaults to False

params.name: next_page_token
params.description: The token to retrieve the next page of calendars. Optional.

tools.name: GoogleCalendar_ListEvents
tools.description: List events from the specified calendar within the given datetime range. min_end_datetime serves as the lower bound (exclusive) for an event's end time. max_start_datetime serves as the upper bound (exclusive) for an event's start time. For example: If min_end_datetime is set to 2024-09-15T09:00:00 and max_start_datetime is set to 2024-09-16T17:00:00, the function will return events that: 1. End after 09:00 on September 15, 2024 (exclusive) 2. Start before 17:00 on September 16, 2024 (exclusive)

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: The ID of the calendar to list events from

params.name: max_results
params.description: The maximum number of events to return

params.name: min_end_datetime
params.description: Filter by events that end on or after this datetime in ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-09-15T09:00:00'.

params.name: max_start_datetime
params.description: Filter by events that start before this datetime in ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-09-16T17:00:00'.

tools.name: GoogleCalendar_RespondToEvent
tools.description: Accept or decline (RSVP to) a meeting invitation on the authenticated user's behalf. Sets the user's responseStatus for an event they were invited to.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID of the event to respond to. Use the event id from list_events to respond to a single occurrence of a recurring event, or its recurringEventId to respond to the whole series.

params.name: response
params.description: The RSVP response: accepted or declined.

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: The ID of the calendar containing the event

params.name: send_updates
params.description: Should attendees be notified of the response? (none, all, external_only)

tools.name: GoogleCalendar_UpdateEvent
tools.description: Update an existing event in the specified calendar with the provided details. Only the provided fields will be updated; others will remain unchanged. `updated_start_datetime` and `updated_end_datetime` are independent and can be provided separately.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID of the event to update

params.name: updated_summary
params.description: The updated title of the event

params.name: updated_location
params.description: The updated location of the event

params.name: updated_recurrence
params.description: Updated recurrence rules for a repeating event, in RFC 5545 format. Each entry is an RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE line; a bare rule is automatically prefixed with 'RRULE:'. Provide the full set of rules to repl

params.name: updated_visibility
params.description: The visibility of the event

params.name: updated_calendar_id
params.description: The updated ID of the calendar containing the event.

params.name: updated_description
params.description: The updated description of the event

params.name: updated_google_meet
params.description: Whether to update the Google Meet link to the event. (none, add, remove)

params.name: updated_end_datetime
params.description: The updated datetime that the event ends in ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-12-31T17:30:00'.

params.name: attendee_emails_to_add
params.description: The list of attendee emails to add. Must be valid email addresses e.g., username@domain.com.

params.name: updated_start_datetime
params.description: The updated datetime that the event starts in ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-12-31T15:30:00'.

params.name: attendee_emails_to_remove
params.description: The list of attendee emails to remove. Must be valid email addresses e.g., username@domain.com.

tools.name: GoogleCalendar_WhoAmI
tools.description: Get comprehensive user profile and Google Calendar environment information. This tool provides detailed information about the authenticated user including their name, email, profile picture, Google Calendar access permissions, and other important profile details from Google services.
